turns.text: As the dock office clerk of Port Ellin, assign this berth request to exactly one fee class: resident | transit | commercial. Request: 'Kestrel, a charter yacht taking paying guests on day sails.' Reply with the class only.

For your records, a correction to your last assignment: vessels carrying paying passengers are always commercial, not transit or resident; private visiting yachts without paying passengers are transit; boats licensed to local operators are resident. Note the correction in one line.
Afternoon shift at the dock office. The standing fee-class rules apply. Confirm in one line.
Assign this berth request to its fee class; the harbor register is not at hand. Request: 'Merlin, a private motor yacht visiting for the weekend, no passengers for hire.' Reply with the class only.
